name: Trip Logistics Assistant
description:
No account, no sign-up, no API key — connect it and just ask in plain language. Trip Logistics Assistant turns trip questions into concrete, bookable options right in the conversation: real figures, context and a direct booking link.

• Car rental and car hire — price ranges and local tips for key airports, plus direct links for 1,800+ cities and 870 airports worldwide, comparing live offers from hundreds of rental car companies (via DiscoverCars).
• Airport transfers and airport pickups with a private driver — pre-booked door-to-door rides in 1,100+ cities, sedans to minibuses, not a taxi or shuttle app (via GetTransfer).
• Tours, attractions and tickets — live prices and ratings for attraction tickets and self-guided audio tours (via WeGoTrip).
• Travel eSIM and data plans — mobile data for 200+ countries instead of roaming charges or a local SIM card, from a daily-refreshed catalog (via Airalo).
• Luggage storage, left luggage and baggage storage — flat per-day rates to drop your bags near stations and landmarks in 1,300+ cities, security guarantee included (via Radical Storage).
• Flight compensation — free eligibility check after a flight delay, a cancelled flight or denied boarding: up to €600 per passenger under EU 261, up to 3 years back (via AirHelp).

Honest by design: cards say exactly what the numbers are — live catalog prices where available, typical ranges where not. Final prices are always on the partner's page. Booking links are affiliate links; your price is unchanged, and this is how it stays free. We never handle payments or personal data. Works in any language you use with Claude.

Examples: "rent a car at Malaga airport Aug 10-17" · "transfer from Vienna airport to the city centre for two" · "tickets for the Colosseum on August 15" · "eSIM for Italy for a week" · "where can I leave my luggage in Rome for a day" · "my flight was delayed 4 hours, can I get compensation?"

https://triplogistics.app · Privacy: https://triplogistics.app/privacy.html

_published_faq.name: How do I add Trip Logistics Assistant to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Trip Logistics Assistant to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.triplogistics.app/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Trip Logistics Assistant MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, Trip Logistics Assistant scores 86/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Trip Logistics Assistant MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Trip Logistics Assistant provides these MCP tools: check_flight_compensation, search_car_rentals, search_esim, search_luggage_storage, search_tours, and search_transfers.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Trip Logistics Assistant?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Trip Logistics Assistant in travel on the Manufact MCP catalog include ChargeHub, Inbin Pulse, PLAZA Hotels, Point Hacks, and Skimetric.

_published_faq.name: Does Trip Logistics Assistant MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Trip Logistics Assistant does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
Trip Logistics Assistant is developed by Petr Kushnir. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
